snippet: Commercial banks end the year on a profit or loss, but what about a central bank like De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB)? And what happens if DNB makes a profit, or indeed a loss? Does DNB maintain buffers to absorb losses? And what’s the financial bottom line after 23 years of working with the euro?

title: Speech Steven Maijoor - Data Science for Supervision: What’s in it for us?
snippet: How can supervisors leverage data even better in supervision? This is the key question in Steven Maijoor’s speech at the Data Science Conference of the DNB Data Science Hub.

title: Speech Steven Maijoor - “On how climate-related and environmental risks affect banking and its prudential supervision”
snippet: On 11 May, Steven Maijoor spoke at the AFME European Sustainable Finance conference. He talked about how climate-related and environmental (C&E) risks affect the financial system and about how supervisors and banks must respond to these risks.

title: Speech Klaas Knot - Diverse challenges, common threads: Preserving global financial stability today and tomorrow
snippet: On May 11, Klaas Knot spoke at the International Swaps and Derivatives Association in Madrid in his capacity as chairman of the Financial Stability Board (FSB). He talked about the current challenges to global financial stability and the measures being taken by the FSB to address them.

title: Dutch institutional investors increasingly turn to high-risk bonds
snippet: In the past two years, Dutch institutional investors increasingly preferred riskier high-yield (HY) bonds over their safer investment-grade (IG) counterparts. Most of these investments in HY debt securities are made abroad, for example in US firms and Brazilian and South African governments.

title: DNB starts compensation payouts to customers of Amsterdam Trade Bank
snippet: From today, savers at Amsterdam Trade Bank (ATB) can get their savings back, up to €100,000 per person. This means most account holders will regain access to their savings within a few business days.

title: Dutch pension funds’ financial position improved
snippet: In the first quarter of 2022, Dutch pension funds saw their financial position improve for the eighth consecutive quarter, as the value of their liabilities showed a steeper decline than their assets.

title: DNB activates deposit guarantee scheme for Amsterdam Trade Bank N.V. customers
snippet: On 22 April 2022, De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) decided to activate the Dutch deposit guarantee scheme (DGS) for account holders of Amsterdam Trade Bank N.V. (ATB). DNB administers the Dutch Deposit Guarantee on behalf of the Dutch government.

title: Update on Amsterdam Trade Bank
snippet: The public and the media have raised questions about service provision at Amsterdam Trade Bank (ATB). De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) is in close consultation with the institution and we expect to be able to provide further information shortly.

title: Increasing preference for contactless payments
snippet: Dutch people increasingly prefer paying contactless, using either debit cards or devices such as mobile phones, smartwatches and wearables. The use of cash slightly declined during 2021, with one in five payments being made in cash.

title: New covenant lays down agreements on proper functioning of cash
snippet: Twenty-three organisations closely involved in the Dutch payment system signed a new Cash Covenant this week. The aim of the agreements is to ensure that cash continues to function properly as a means of payment at points of sale in the face of a steady increase in electronic payments.

title: Coronavirus support has been effective, but different approach needed for the future
snippet: During the coronavirus (COVID-19) crisis, the Dutch government supported trade and industry with a comprehensive package of measures.

title: Trust at the heart of the DNB Payments Strategy
snippet: In these times of increasing digitalisation, the new Payments Strategy of De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) focuses on safeguarding trust.

title: Lasting effects of the pandemic on the economy and finance
snippet: On 25 March, Klaas Knot gave a masterclass at the Treasury Fair organised by DACT (Dutch Association of Corporate Treasurers). Klaas talked about the lasting effects of the COVID-19 pandemic on our economies and on finance.

title: Dutch households’ investments grew to over EUR 180 billion in 2021
snippet: Since year-end 2018, the value of investments held by Dutch households has increased by EUR 58 billion to over EUR 185 billion at year-end 2021, according to the first publication of new DNB statistics on households’ investments. This growth was mainly driven by price gains.

title: Interview Klaas Knot with Les Echos
snippet: Interview with Klaas Knot, conducted by Guillaume Benoît and Sophie Rolland of les Echos, published on March 21, 2022. See the English and French version below.

title: Value of outstanding Dutch securitisations below that of covered bonds for the first time
snippet: At 31 December 2021, the volume of Dutch securitisations outstanding, also referred to as re-packaged loans, stood at €168 billion.

title: Introduction by the President at the press conference for DNB’s 2021 Annual Report
snippet: Let me begin by saying how satisfying it is to see you all in person again, after two years of virtual press conferences, for the presentation of our annual report. Current world affairs make that feeling of satisfaction rather relative, however.

title: The expenditure rule can contribute to credible debt reduction and countercyclical fiscal policies
snippet: European fiscal rules could become more effective if they were aimed more at public spending and less at the size of the public deficit and debt.

title: Speech Steven Maijoor - Banking in the digital age: seizing opportunities, managing risks
snippet: The topic of this event is called ‘who has power in financial markets’. This is an intriguing question. As recent events show, financial markets do not operate in isolation, in a vacuum – so to speak.

title: Financial sanctions: who does what, and who monitors this?
snippet: What should banks, insurers, trust offices and other financial institutions do now that so many sanctions have been imposed? And is this process monitored?

title: The sanctions against Russia at a glance
snippet: The European Union has imposed a range of financial sanctions against Russia in the last few days. Below is an overview of the various sanctions.

title: Latest news on sanctions against Russia
snippet: The European Union has imposed and announced various sanctions against Russia in the last few weeks. Follow the latest news on the sanctions and their impact on the financial sector, payments and the economy. We will update this page on a regular basis.

title: Five questions about SWIFT [update of 4 March]
snippet: The European Union has announced that it will disconnect Russian banks from SWIFT. What is SWIFT, who does it belong to, and what are the consequences if a country is excluded?

title: What do the sanctions against the Central Bank of Russia mean?
snippet: The European Union imposed sanctions against the Central Bank of Russia on 28 February. As a result, the Russian central bank can no longer access its assets at private institutions and central banks in the European Union.

title: Speech Klaas Knot - A global Europe to meet global financial stability challenges
snippet: In his speech at Eurofi, Klaas Knot spoke in his capacity as Chair of the Financial Stability Board about the Covid exit, digitalization and climate change.

title: Nine questions on the sanctions and the economic consequences of the war
snippet: The European Union has imposed a range of sanctions on Russia. What are financial sanctions, what are the consequences of these sanctions for the Netherlands and how does the war affect our economy? Read our answers to the main questions.

title: Navigating change in the global financial system: the role of the FSB
snippet: In his speech as FSB Chair befor the G20 Finance Ministers and Governors, Klaas Knot said we may have seen only the beginning of the changes that the pandemic, digitalization and climate change are bringing to the financial system, and our economies more widely.

title: Dutch financial institutions invest heavily in new EU bonds
snippet: Dutch investments in EU bonds are among the top three largest within the European Union (EU). The capital raised with these bonds is used to finance the European Commission's (EC) extensive COVID-19 recovery plans.

title: Carbon pricing – economic impact and preconditions
snippet: A European or Dutch carbon tax will affect the Dutch economy in almost equal measure. Our economy will actually benefit from an international tax, however.

title: DNB's history is closely intertwined with slavery: DNB starts a process of reflection
snippet: Between 1814 and 1863, De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) and its former directors were involved in slavery. This emerges from by independent scholarly study conducted by Leiden University, which was published today. We deeply regret these findings.

title: Speech Steven Maijoor - Changing landscape, changing supervision: preserving financial stability in times of tech revolution
snippet: In his speech at the 6th Annual Afore Conference, Steven Maijoor spoke about the complexity of reshaping regulation and supervision in a financial sector where platforms and new technology play in increasingly important role.

title: Encourage homeowners to make their homes more sustainable
snippet: In the coming years, many new homes will have to be made more sustainable. That will not happen by itself. At present, homeowners often refrain from investing in insulation or a heat pump, for example. This is partly due to financial bottlenecks.

title: Financial sector presents roadmap to circular economy
snippet: The financial sector as a driver of the circular economy. How do we achieve this? The Circular Economy Working Group of the Sustainable Finance Platform puts forward proposals for a number of concrete actions.

title: Dutch banks: “demand for loans to enterprises increased in late 2021”
snippet: Demand for loans to enterprises increased in the second half of 2021 as firms became more willing to invest.

title: Households saved less in 2021 than in first year of the COVID-19 pandemic
snippet: In 2021, Dutch households continued to save heavily. The total balance in current and savings accounts of Dutch households increased by €33.8 billion to a total of €528.4 billion in 2021.

title: Number of counterfeit euro banknotes remains stable
snippet: A total of 26,100 counterfeit euro banknotes were withdrawn from circulation in the Netherlands in 2021, roughly the same number as in 2020. Worldwide, a total of 347,000 counterfeit euro banknotes were detected, a decrease of 25% compared to 2020.

title: Financial position of Dutch pension funds improved in fourth quarter of 2021
snippet: In the fourth quarter of 2021, Dutch pension funds saw their financial position improve for the seventh consecutive quarter, as pension assets increased by €63 billion to €1,815 billion, while the value of liabilities remained virtually unchanged at €1,588 billion.

title: Speech Klaas Knot - ‘The ability and the will to act’
snippet: Good financial supervision is not only about the ability but also about the will to act. This requires supervisors to have a clear and unambiguous mandate, operational independence coupled with accountability, and a relationship with industry and government that avoids regulatory capture.

title: Better insight into bitcoin's climate impact
snippet: The total carbon footprint of the bitcoin network increased by about 25% in 2020, while the number of transactions fell by 6%. This amounts to a climate impact of about 402 kg of CO2 per bitcoin transaction in 2020,

title: Banks' profits under pressure in persistently low interest rate environment
snippet: Higher interest rate levels are favourable for the banking sector. But a scenario of persistently low interest rates poses challenges.

title: FD sentiment indicator annual overview: 2021 in the rear-view mirror
snippet: The FD sentiment indicator, based on articles in Dutch financial daily Het Financieele Dagblad (FD), has partially recovered following a sharp drop at the start of the coronavirus crisis.

title: Strong economic recovery, despite resurgence of pandemic
snippet: The Dutch economy has shown a rapid and strong recovery from the coronavirus recession of 2020. GDP is expected to grow by 4.5% this year. We have prepared the forecasts for the years ahead at a time of great uncertainty.

title: EIOPA publishes results of stress test for European insurers
snippet: EIOPA, the European supervisory authority for pension funds and insurers, has just published the results of a stress test conducted earlier this year among 44 European insurers.

title: Financial institutions share roadmap to protect biodiversity
snippet: The Biodiversity Working Group of the Sustainable Finance Platform has developed a roadmap to help financial institutions address biodiversity loss. The roadmap offers guidance for institutions that are new to this theme, but also for institutions that have already taken their first steps.

title: European stress test scenario has limited impact on Dutch insurers
snippet: Today, the European supervisory authority for insurers and pension funds (EIOPA) published a detailing the results of a stress test carried out among insurers in the European Union.

title: Minister of Finance sends Conservatrix Evaluation Committee report to the House of Representatives
snippet: This afternoon, the Dutch Minister of Finance sent the report of the Conservatrix Evaluation Committee to the House of Representatives of the Netherlands.

title: Most pension funds have started preparing for the new pension system
snippet: Some 85% of pension funds have started to prepare for the new pension system.

title: Speech Klaas Knot - “On payment trends: opportunities and risks”
snippet: On 9 December, Klaas Knot spoke at the 13th Conference on Payments and Market Infrastructure, jointly organised by the National Bank of North Macedonia and De Nederlandsche Bank.

title: Speech Klaas Knot - “Planning is everything: the FSB’s Key Attributes and what we have learnt from them”
snippet: Speech by Klaas Knot at the FSB/FSI high-level Round Table to mark the 10th year anniversary of the adoption of the Key Attributes of Effective Resolution

title: Sustainability risks can be measured despite data constraints
snippet: The lack of consistent and reliable data makes measuring sustainability risks difficult, but not impossible.

title: Klaas Knot takes office as FSB Chair
snippet: Klaas Knot, President of De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB), today has taken office as Financial Stability Board (FSB) Chair. He has been serving as FSB Vice Chair before taking office.

title: Stable distribution of labour and profit income despite coronavirus crisis
snippet: Despite the coronavirus crisis, the distribution of labour and profit income has remained constant. This is reflected in the labour income share (LIS) development of the market sector in 2020. It is notable that the LIS has remained stable.

title: DNB calls for unambiguous communication about cash acceptance
snippet: Consumers are increasingly paying electronically for in-store purchases. In 3% of stores they have no alternative because the retailer pursues a card-only policy. 27% of retailers use promotional materials to encourage consumers to pay electronically.

title: The surge in euro area inflation during the pandemic: transitory but with upside risks
snippet: After being subdued for a number of years, euro area inflation has recently increased markedly. This raises two main questions. What are the drivers of this development?

title: Institutional investors increasingly investing in SPACs
snippet: Dutch investments in SPACs have increased strongly in the last year, particularly Institutional investors’ investments in these companies.

title: Remarks Klaas Knot - The outlook for inflation and monetary policy in the Euro Area
snippet: At the UBS European Conference today, Klaas Knot spoke about the outlook for inflation and monetary policy in the Euro Area.

title: New mortgage loans mainly provided by institutional investors
snippet: Dutch mortgage debt is also on the rise. Unlike before, it is mainly institutional investors who are responsible for this growth, rather than the banks. In addition, growth is relatively subdued from a historical perspective in relation to the rise in house prices.

title: Speech Olaf Sleijpen - “About failing small in order not to fail big”
snippet: On 5 November, Olaf Sleijpen opened the 24th Annual Research Conference of De Nederlandsche Bank. This year’s conference theme was: “The Economy in Transition: Efficient and Sustainable Policies to Support Business Dynamism”.

title: Supply bottlenecks visible in inflation
snippet: The higher prices that businesses have faced in recent months are increasingly translated into higher consumer prices. This mainly concerns price increases for products that previously exerted downward pressure on inflation in the Netherlands.

title: DNB publishes Pledge COP26
snippet: On 3 November 2021, on Finance Day at the COP26, we will publish a statement in which we pledge, within our mandate, to contribute to a decisive policy commitment to implement the Paris Agreement and to mitigate the impact of climate change.

title: Towards a global price for carbon emissions
snippet: From an economic perspective, pricing is the most efficient means of reducing carbon emissions. As climate change is a worldwide problem, carbon pricing works best with a global price for carbon emissions. However, complete global pricing seems infeasible.

title: Dutch businesses’ creditworthiness: so far, so good
snippet: Banks have not generally lowered their credit assessments of Dutch businesses compared to before the coronavirus crisis. In most of the hardest-hit sectors, non-performing loans have however increased markedly following the outbreak of the pandemic.

title: Financial position of Dutch pension funds improved in third quarter of 2021
snippet: In the third quarter of 2021, Dutch pension funds saw their financial position improve for the sixth consecutive quarter, as growth in their aggregate pension assets outstripped the increase in liabilities.

title: Speech Olaf Sleijpen - “The long run: the road to net zero and the role of central banks”
snippet: In his speech at the Green Economy Conference at the Bank of Lithuania today, Olaf Sleijpen argued that central bank involvement in the race to net zero is both obvious and necessary, given that climate change and other forms of environmental degradation form a major financial stability risk.

title: Safe payments are fundamental to sustaining trust and confidence in the payment system
snippet: A wide range of factors contribute to confidence in the payment system, the most important of which is being able to pay safely. High public confidence in the payment system held up well during these turbulent times.

title: Four key elements for achieving a more balanced housing market
snippet: The overheated Dutch housing market has to contend with multifaceted and urgent issues.

title: Robust economic recovery, but vulnerabilities on the rise
snippet: The economic recovery continues at a robust pace, the search for yield continues and house prices keep going up. Against this backdrop, it is important not to lose sight of growing vulnerabilities and risks to financial stability.

title: Introduction to the press conference
snippet: On 11 October 2021 Klaas Knot presented our six-monthly Financial Stabilty Report. You can read his introductory remarks here.

title: Speech Klaas Knot - “Big tech and financials: a happy marriage?”
snippet: At the BIS Conference on Regulating Big Tech, Klaas Knot said that regulators need to re-examine their regulatory framework to respond to big tech risks to financial stability and competition.

title: SER advisory report represents important step in future-proofing Dutch labour market
snippet: The draft advisory report on social and economic policy for 2021-2025 of the Economic and Social Council of the Netherlands (SER) provides valuable guidance for the incoming government, in particular for curbing the excessive flexibility in the labour market.

title: Return on Dutch investment funds is the highest in the euro area
snippet: The return on Dutch investment funds averaged 7.3% per year over the period from 2015 to July 2021.

title: ECB includes climate change in monetary policy strategy
snippet: The ECB will incorporate climate change considerations in its new monetary policy strategy.

title: ECB to revise analytical framework for monetary decision-making
snippet: The European Central Bank (ECB) has decided to revise and broaden its analyses for monetary decisions. Within the new analytical framework, economic and monetary analyses will be more closely integrated, and more attention will be devoted to long-term developments and financial stability.

title: Home ownership costs to be incorporated in the inflation measure
snippet: The costs of home ownership are to be included in the inflation measure of the European Central Bank (ECB).

title: ECB sets clear and simple inflation target
snippet: Under the new strategy adopted this summer, the European Central Bank (ECB) wants to put an end to the confusion surrounding its inflation target. The ECB has raised its inflation target to 2% from the previous ‘below, but close to, 2%’.

title: Interview Klaas Knot with Bloomberg
snippet: Full quotes of the interview with Klaas Knot, conducted by Carolynn Look and Marton Eder on August 30 2021.

title: Improved European carbon pricing has limited impact on competitiveness
snippet: Implementing an EU-wide tax of €50 per tonne of carbon emitted for the manufacturing, energy and transport sectors will have a modest impact on the competitiveness of the Netherlands and most other EU Member States.

title: Households expect not to spend the vast majority of savings accumulated during the pandemic period on consumption
snippet: Due to the coronavirus measures, households have been saving more, but they only expect to use a mere 14% of these savings for consumption.

title: DNB warns against Binance
snippet: De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) announces that Binance* is providing crypto services in the Netherlands without the required legal registration with DNB.

title: Dutch banking system prepared for implementation of Final Basel III Accord
snippet: In recent years, Dutch banks have strengthened their capital buffers. Four years ago, the largest Dutch banks were expected to need additional capital to meet the minimum standards set out in the Basel Accord.

title: Four questions about unregistered crypto service providers
snippet: Crypto service providers not registered with DNB are not allowed to provide their services in the Netherlands. Four questions about unregistered providers and our supervision.

title: Composition of collateral explains divergent rates in European money market

snippet: Zastupnici u Europskom parlamentu su u četvrtak u Strasbourgu zatražili sankcije protiv Turske zbog njenih provokacija u istočnom Sredozemlju, odnosno povreda grčkog zračnog prostora, dok je Europska komisija pozvala na "održivu deeskalaciju".

title: Europol razbio narkomrežu povezanu s ubojstvima, uhićenje i u Hrvatskoj
snippet: U međunarodnoj operaciji protiv kriminalne mreže povezane sa Zapadnim Balkanom uhićeno je 47 osoba, među njima jedna u Hrvatskoj, a skupinu povezuju s krijumčarenjem velike količine droge, ubojstvima, otmicama i nasilnim obračunima diljem Europe.

title: Meloni dobila konačno odobrenje parlamenta za spornu izbornu reformu
snippet: Talijanski Zastupnički dom u četvrtak je dao konačno odobrenje kontroverznoj izbornoj reformi koju je zagovarala premijerka Giorgia Meloni, a koja bi mogla imati ključan utjecaj na ishod parlamentarnih izbora zakazanih za iduću godinu.

title: Eurozastupnici pozdravili strategije EU-a za otoke i najudaljenije regije
snippet: Europska unija po prvi put ima strategije za otoke, obalne zajednice i najudaljenije regije koji se suočavaju sa specifičnim izazovima, istaknuo je izvršni potpredsjednik Europske komisije Raffaele Fitto u Strasbourgu.

title: Ukrajina kaže da je pogodila najveću rusku rafineriju nafte
snippet: U ruskom bombardiranju ukrajinskog grada Kramatorska na istoku zemlje poginule su najmanje 33 osobe, objavile su u četvrtak ukrajinske vlasti te ocijenile da je riječ o namjernom napadu na civile u važnom uporištu koje Rusija nastoji zauzeti. A ukrajinska vojska priopćila je da je pogodila najveću…

title: Hutisti tvrde da su napali zračnu luku u Rijadu; eskalira sukob u Jemenu
snippet: Jemenski hutisti rekli su da su izveli novi napad na važnu zračnu luku u Saudijskoj Arabiji te upozorili da su sva naftna postrojenja u toj zemlji mete te skupine povezane s Iranom.

title: Novinar Ljubić: Model izbora u BiH mora se mijenjati
snippet: Novinar Marko Ljubić za HRT-ov "Studio 4" rekao je kako su izbori političku scenu u BiH vratili na početne pozicije koje su definirane Daytonskim ugovorom.

title: Srbija: Odbijen zahtjev oporbe za usporedbu elektroničkog i tiskanog popisa birača
snippet: Komisija za reviziju popisa birača odbila je zahtjev oporbe i civilnog sektora da im dostavi elektroničke izvode iz Jedinstvenog biračkog spiska (JBS), što u jeku kampanje za izbore 25. listopada dodatno budi sumnje u transparentnost izbornog procesa i mogućnost zlouporaba, pišu u četvrtak beograds…

title: Poznat uzrok požara u napuštenom Teatru Fenice
snippet: Uzrok sinoćnjeg požara u napuštenoj zgradi Teatra Fenice je tehničke prirode, doznajemo iz Policijske uprave primorsko-goranske nakon završenog očevida.

title: HMNK Rijeka u subotu protiv Osijek Kandita
snippet: Hrvatski malonogometni klub Rijeka održao je danas konferenciju za novinare na kojoj je najavljena subotnja utakmica 3. kola SuperSport Hrvatske malonogometne lige protiv Osijek Kandita, koja se igra od 18 sati u Dvorani Zamet.

title: Matjaž Kek: „Lay Lady Lay" me vraća u neka druga vremena
snippet: U emisiji „Moja stvar" Radio Rijeke gostovao je trener NK Rijeke Matjaž Kek, koji je otkrio pjesmu uz koju ga vežu mladost i lijepa sjećanja: „Lay Lady Lay" Boba Dylana.

title: Odvoz glomaznog otpada: velik broj vozila KD Čistoće - na servisu!
snippet: Pitanje i pritužbu na odvoz glomaznog otpada, naša je sugrađanka poslala Radio Rijeci. Nije, piše, uspjela dobiti termin, iako na to ima pravo besplatno jednom godišnje.

title: Missed cancer diagnosis apology 'too little, too late'
snippet: University Hospital Galway has apologised to a woman who was diagnosed with terminal brain cancer in 2023 after a number of scans were misinterpreted.

title: Search warrants for ex-prince Andrew's homes 'unlawful'
snippet: A criminal investigation into former prince Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor is ongoing despite the search warrants that allowed British police officers to raid two of his properties being ruled unlawful, the High Court has heard.

title: Russian bomb kills 33 in street in east Ukraine city
snippet: Ukraine accused Russia of deliberately targeting civilians after 30 people were killed when two buses were blown up in the frontline city of Kramatorsk.

title: Young nurse feels 'unhopeful about the future' in Ireland
snippet: A young nurse has said she feels 'unhopeful' about her future in Ireland and is planning to move to Australia at the end of the month.

title: Man denies murdering three family members in Louth home
snippet: A 32-year-old man has denied murdering three members of his family at their home in Co Louth last year by stabbing them repeatedly in what was described as a sustained and violent attack.

title: Bar worker who miscarried paid €25k for unfair dismissal
snippet: A Galway hospitality firm which dismissed a manager just 11 days after she suffered a miscarriage, before trying to claim that maternity protection law didn't apply since she wasn't pregnant any longer, has been ordered to pay her €25,000.

title: Opposition TDs mull Dáil boycott over strike pickets
snippet: Opposition TDs are contemplating boycotting Wednesday's Dáil sitting should they be required to pass the picket of striking Oireachtas workers.

title: Inside the Russian town grappling with plague scare
snippet: Russia has downplayed the plague scare but on the streets of Shelekhov - the town on the frontlines of the incident - rumours have filled the information abyss.

title: Politicians trade blame after death of evictee in Spain
snippet: Spanish politicians have traded blame after the death of an 87-year-old woman whose eviction from her home in the capital Madrid sparked housing protests across the country.

title: UL warn students after 'simply unnacceptable' vandalism
snippet: The University of Limerick has warned students that anti-social behaviour will not be tolerated following the extensive vandalism of a vacant house in Castletroy.

title: Man accused of attacking Michael Healy-Rae granted bail
snippet: A man accused of carrying out an "unprovoked" attack on Kerry TD Michael Healy-Rae as he sat in traffic in Dublin has been granted High Court bail.

title: Canadian writer Carson wins Nobel Prize in Literature
snippet: Canadian poet and writer Anne Carson has won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature "for her bold and inventive oeuvre that, in playful dialogue with the classical ⁠tradition, has created new forms for contemporary literature," the award-giving body said today.

title: Annual inflation at highest level since January 2024
snippet: A considerable jump in the cost of energy drove consumer prices 4.1% higher in the year to September, according to latest figures from the Central Statistics Office.

title: Pike may face execution after recovery, says US doctor
snippet: A medical adviser to Christa Pike's legal team has said the more her condition improves, the more likely she is to eventually face execution.

title: Minister to 'appraise' data on legal aid reforms
snippet: Minister for Justice Jim O'Callaghan has said that he will "appraise" the data in relation to criminal legal aid reforms and make changes if he believes they are needed.

title: Maduro and wife Flores charged in US over alleged torture
snippet: Ousted Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro and his wife Cilia Flores were hit with an additional US criminal charge stemming from accusations they tortured political opponents while in power.

title: HSE expects flu jabs for recommended groups despite delay
snippet: The HSE flu vaccines are being delivered on a phased basis, and it expects to have free vaccines for everyone in the recommended groups despite delays.

title: 'Obsessed' Ward bats away contract talk ahead of play-off
snippet: Republic of Ireland boss Carla Ward would not be drawn on whether the FAI have opened talks over a contract extension, and said she's "obsessed" with guiding the Girls in Green to the World Cup in Brazil next summer.

title: State migration budget to fall by €682 million next year
snippet: Minister for Justice Jim O'Callaghan has said that the state's migration budget will fall by 38% next year - a reduction of €682 million.

title: Bad COP, worse COP? EU tempers hopes for UN climate talks
snippet: Fragile time for global climate diplomacy as Turkey and Australia's unique joint leadership of COP31 raises doubts about ability to deliver concrete results.

title: Thousands attend anti-Bolsonaro protest in Rio
snippet: Thousands of people marched in downtown Rio de Janeiro in a student protest against presidential election favorite Flavio Bolsonaro.

title: PAC to write to RTÉ and Media Dept over funding concerns
snippet: The chairperson of the Public Accounts Committee John Brady has said members have requested a copy of the agreement made between the RTÉ and the Department of Culture, Communications and Sport.

title: Lithuania plans €4.8 billion for defence in 2027, substantial budget deficit
snippet: Lithuania plans to allocate about 4.8 billion euros to defense next year, or slightly more than 5% of gross domestic product, Prime Minister Mindaugas Sinkevičius said Thursday.

title: Troops at Kaliningrad border are for stopping mobilisation dodgers – Lithuanian minister
snippet: Lithuania will deploy up to 100 troops to help guard its border with Russia’s Kaliningrad region over the next several weeks. Interior Minister Martynas Katelynas said the move was a precautionary measure anticipating Russian men seeking asylum from potential military mobilisation.

title: Māksliniece Dzimstna Bērziņa ieguvusi «SEB stipendiju glezniecībā»
snippet: Septembrī Latvijas Mākslas akadēmijā (LMA) tika atklāta jau astoņpadsmitā "SEB stipendijas glezniecībā" darbu izstāde, kurā viens no jaunajiem māksliniekiem tiek pasludināts par stipendijas ieguvēju. Jaunajiem māksliniekiem tā ir ne tikai iespēja pretendēt uz finansiālu atbalstu savai radošajai dar…

title: Arhitektu reģionos trūkst tāpat kā ārstu: Daugavpilī diskutē par nozares nākotni
snippet: Ar Latvijas arhitektūras ģēnijam Gunāram Birkertam veltītas izstādes atklāšanu un pieredzes apmaiņu Daugavpilī ceturtdien, 8. oktobrī, aizvadītas Arhitektūras dienas. Līdzās arhitektūras sasniegumiem uzmanības centrā arī problēmas – reģionos trūkst arhitektu, bet topošajam Arhitektūras likumam būtu…

title: Pēc masu kapa izpētes Liepājā atklāj memoriālu holokausta upuriem
snippet: Liepājā atklāts memoriāls, kas godina cilvēkus, kuri nacistiskās okupācijas laikā tika vardarbīgi deportēti no dažādām Eiropas valstīm, ieslodzīti geto un koncentrācijas nometnēs, bet vēlāk nogādāti Liepājā. Atjaunotā memoriāla atklāšanai tieši 8. oktobrī ir dziļi simboliska nozīme, jo šajā dienā t…

title: Kurzemes militārajā bāzē Speciālo uzdevumu bataljons mācās savaldīt agresīvu pūli
snippet: Valsts policijas Speciālo uzdevumu bataljons aizvadījis taktiskās mācības, pārbaudot gatavību masu nekārtību likvidēšanā un bruņotu noziedznieku neitralizēšanā, vēsta Latvijas Televīzija.

title: Divi Latvijas pilsoņi aizturēti aizdomās par nelikumīgu iekļūšanu Lielbritānijas militārajā bāzē
snippet: Aizdomās par nelikumīgu iekļūšanu Lielbritānijas Karalisko gaisa spēku (RAF) militārajā bāzē Kembridžšīrā Anglijas dienvidaustrumos 8. oktobrī aizturēti divi Latvijas pilsoņi.

title: Griestu stāvokļa dēļ slēdz policijas iecirkņa ēku Jēkabpilī
snippet: Vienā no Valsts policijas Austrumzemgales iecirkņa ēkām Jēkabpilī nokritis griestu apmetums, tāpēc ēka ir slēgta ekspluatācijai. Kamēr nebūs novērsti drošības riski, darbinieki ir pārcelti uz citām telpām. Nodrošinājuma valsts aģentūrā atzīst, ka ēkai nav veikti kapitāli remontdarbi finansējuma trū…

title: Medijs: Spiegošanā apsūdzētais bijušais Vācijas izlūku šefs Hannings kontaktējies ar Ķīnas ģenerālmajoru
snippet: Bijušais Vācijas ārējā izlūkdienesta (BND) priekšnieks Augusts Hannings, kas otrdien tika aizturēts aizdomās par spiegošanu un valsts nodevību, gadiem ilgi uzturēja kontaktus ar Ķīnas ģenerālmajoru, noskaidrojis žurnāls "Der Spiegel". Izmeklētāji arī pārbauda, vai Hannings nodeva slepenu informācij…

title: «Sākumā meita brīžiem it kā aizdomājās.» Mazās Olīvijas mamma Karīna par retās slimības gaitu un cerības meklējumiem
snippet: Pirmās pārmaiņas, ko meitiņā ievēroja mazās Olīvijas mamma Karīna Rusecka, bija it kā aizdomāšanās ik pa laikam. Vēlāk pievienojās lēkmes, kam sekoja mēnešiem ilgi izmeklējumi, līdz atklāja retu, ģenētisku saslimšanu. Karīna ir apņēmības pilna cīnīties par zālēm, kas Olīvijas dzīves kvalitāti varēt…

snippet: Nesen aizvadītās Krievijas Valsts domes vēlēšanas bija pilnīgs farss, ceturtdien apstiprinātajā rezolūcijā norāda Eiropas Parlamenta (EP) deputāti. Eiroparlamentārieši aicina neatzīt jaunievēlēto Krievijas parlamenta apakšpalātu kā likumīgu varas orgānu. Debatēs īpaši tika nosodīta balsošanas sarīk…

title: Bez Miksones, bet ar domu par pieredzi. Latvijas futbolistēm priekšā grūts pārbaudījums – Francijas izlase
snippet: Latvijas sieviešu futbola izlasei sestdien priekšā pēdējo gadu grūtākais pretinieks – izbraukumā jāspēkojas ar francūzietēm. Lai gan tā būs pārbaudes spēle, tā nesola neko vienkāršu, jo Francija ir viena no planētas spēcīgākajām komandām sieviešu futbolā. Par gatavošanās procesu un sajūtām pirms li…

title: Mūžībā devusies tekstilmāksliniece un tautas lietišķās mākslas tradīciju glabātāja Vija Ābele
snippet: 5. oktobrī mūžībā devusies tekstilmāksliniece, ilggadējā Tautas lietišķās mākslas studijas "Krimulda" vadītāja Vija Ābele, pavēstījis Latvijas Nacionālais kultūras centrs (LNKC).

title: Ukrainā stingrie taupības pasākumi aizkavē algu izmaksu; Ļvivas mērs iesaldē savu algu
snippet: Ukrainai pašlaik jācīnās ne vien pret Krievijas droniem, raķetēm un vadāmajām aviobumbām, bet arī pamatīgi jāsavelk jostas, lai aizlāpītu milzīgo caurumu šā gada valsts budžetā un turpinātu finansēt armiju.

title: Ļebedevs ceturto gadu pēc kārtas būs pasaules spīdveja čempionāta dalībnieku vidū
snippet: Ceturtdien Starptautiskās Motosporta federācijas (FIM) paziņotajā 15 spīdvejistu sarakstā startam nākamā gada pasaules čempionātā jeb "Grand Prix" ir arī Latvijas labākais spīdvejists Andžejs Ļebedevs, ziņo Latvijas posma organizatori.

title: Vai zini, kā 20. gadsimta sākumā mūzikas instrumentu spēli apguva daudzi Liepājas bērni?
snippet: Pirms Liepājā tika nodibināta Tautas konservatorija, kvalitatīvu mūzikas izglītību varēja iegūt Gabriela Vikera (1880–1940) organizētajos Skaņu mākslas kursos. Vikers ir dzimis Viļņā. snippet: Vairāk laika diskusijām par tā saukto "Netflix" nodokli jeb prasību straumēšanas platformām ieguldīt Latvijas filmu un seriālu veidošanā – tā ceturtdien, 8. oktobrī, lēma Saeima, atceļot grozījumiem Filmu likumā un Elektronisko plašsaziņas līdekļu likumā iepriekš noteikto steidzamību. snippet: Nākamā gada valsts budžets jāsagatavo vēl līdz jaunās valdības apstiprināšanai. title: Par slimības lapas viltošanu tiesātais deputāts Jakovins administratīvi sodīts par pārkāpumiem darbnespējas lapas izsniegšanā
snippet: Saeimas deputāts un ģimenes ārsts Juris Jakovins (Zaļo un Zemnieku savienība), kurš Rīgas pilsētas tiesā atzīts par vainīgu viltota ārsta izraksta izsniegšanā advokātei, kura to izmantoja, lai neierastos uz kādu civillietu, saukts pie administratīvās atbildības par līdzīgiem pārkāpumiem.

title: «Sadales tīkls» vētras seku kompensācijās klientiem izmaksājis 350 000 eiro
snippet: Latvijas elektroenerģijas sadales sistēmas operators AS "Sadales tīkls" (ST) saistībā ar elektroapgādes pārtraukumu augusta vētras laikā klientiem kompensācijās izmaksājis apmēram 350 000 eiro, intervijā Latvijas Radio atklāja valdes priekšsēdētājs Vīgants Radziņš.

title: Tiesai atgriež lietu par kara noziegumu publisku slavināšanu, logos izvietojot Krievijas simboliku
snippet: Augstākā tiesa atcēlusi Rīgas apgabaltiesas lēmumu lietā, kurā apsūdzētajai piespiests trīs gadu cietumsods par noziegumu pret mieru un kara noziegumu publisku slavināšanu, izvietojot savas dzīvesvietas logos dažādus ar Krieviju un Padomju Savienību saistītus simbolus. Iepriekš ziņots, ka apsūdzētā…

title: Premjers Valsts kancelejas direktora amatam oficiāli virza LDDK ģenerāldirektoru Gorkšu
snippet: Atklātajā konkursā uz Valsts kancelejas direktora amatu pēc trešās un noslēdzošās kārtas premjers Andris Kulbergs ("Apvienotais saraksts") apstiprināšanai virzīs Latvijas Darba devēju konfederācijas (LDDK) ģenerāldirektoru Kasparu Gorkšu.

title: Polijā divu dienu laikā otrais uzbrukums skolās – Viškovā pusaudzis nodūris darbinieci
snippet: Polijā 15 gadus vecs pusaudzis ceturtdien savā bijušajā skolā nodūris skolas darbinieci un ievainojis vēl divus citus pieaugušos. Uzbrucējs aizturēts, taču viņa rīcības motīvs pagaidām nav zināms. Incidents notika tikai dienu pēc tam, kad trešdien kāds jaunietis uzbrukumā ar mačeti ievainoja astoņu…

title: Nobela prēmija literatūrā piešķirta kanādiešu dzejniecei un esejistei Annai Kārsonei
snippet: Nobela prēmija literatūrā šogad piešķirta kanādiešu dzejniecei un esejistei Annai Kārsonei par viņas "drosmīgo un inovatīvo daiļradi, kas rotaļīgā dialogā ar klasisko tradīciju radījusi jaunas mūsdienu literatūras formas".

title: Saeima jau atkal atliek «divu grozu» principa ieviešanu veselības aprūpē vēl uz gadu
snippet: Saeima atliek tā saucamo divu veselības aprūpes pakalpojumu grozu principa ieviešanu vēl uz gadu – līdz nākamā gada 31. decembrim, tā ceturtdien otrajā galējā lasījumā steidzamības kārtā lēma parlamentā. Šī principa ieviešanu atliek jau vairākus gadus.

title: 15. Saeimas vēlēšanās ārvalstīs visaktīvāk balsoja Lielbritānijā, Vācijā un ASV; pa pastu nobalsoja gandrīz 4500 cilvēku
snippet: 15. Saeimas vēlēšanās ārvalstīs piedalījušies 23 196 vēlētāju un lielākā aktivitāte bijusi Apvienotajā Karalistē, kur vēlēšanās piedalījās 3703 Latvijas pilsoņi, Vācijā – 2806, Amerikas Savienotajās valstīs – 1558, apkopojusi Ārlietu ministrija.

title: Pretī nāk suns bez saimnieka – kā pareizi rīkoties?
snippet: Suņu uzbrukums bērniem Carnikavā vēlreiz pierādīja – diemžēl nevar paļauties uz to, ka visi saimnieki būs atbildīgi, bet viņu suņi labi audzināti. Gan bērniem, gan pieaugušajiem būtiski zināt, kā reaģēt, sastopoties ar suni bez saimnieka.

title: Saasinās Ukrainas un Dienvidkorejas strīds: Seula atsauc vēstnieku no Kijivas
snippet: Dienvidkoreja ir nolēmusi atsaukt vēstnieku Ukrainā, padziļinoties abu valstu diplomātiskajam strīdam par Ukrainā sagūstītu Ziemeļkorejas karavīru nodošanu Dienvidkorejai.

title: Gada inflācija septembrī − 3,2%; visvairāk sadārdzinājās transports
snippet: 2026. gada septembrī, salīdzinot ar 2026. gada augustu, vidējais patēriņa cenu līmenis palielinājās par 0,2 %, bet gada laikā, salīdzinot ar 2025. gada septembri, pieauga par 3,2 %, liecina Centrālās statistikas pārvaldes (CSP) dati. Būtiskākā ietekme uz cenu pieaugumu mēneša laikā bija transporta…

title: ASV, iespējams, gatavojas atsākt karadarbību Irānā; spriedze Hormuza šaurumā saglabājas
snippet: Baltais nams gatavojas iespējai atsākt karadarbību pret Irānu ASV Kongresa vidustermiņa vēlēšanu priekšvakarā, vēsta vairāki mediji. Kamēr tiek ziņots, ka naftas tranzīts caur Hormuza šaurumu Irānas tuvumā ir atjaunojies pirmskara apmēros, uzbrukumi tankkuģiem turpinās. Un, reaģējot uz reģionā noti…

title: Deputātiem liedz izbraukt uz Baltkrieviju un Krieviju
snippet: Saeima ceturtdien, 8. oktobrī, galīgajā lasījumā atbalstīja grozījumu Nacionālo drošību apdraudošu pasākumu ierobežošanas likumā, nosakot pašvaldību deputātiem izbraukšanas aizliegumu uz Krieviju un Baltkrieviju. Aizliegums attiecas arī uz šo agresorvalstu teritoriju šķērsošanu tranzītā.

title: Cinemas portugueses com quebra de 3,7% de espectadores em setembro
snippet: Os cinemas portugueses registaram uma quebra de 3,7% no número de espectadores em setembro, por comparação com o mês homólogo de 2025, para um total de 748 mil, revelou hoje o Instituto do Cinema e do Audiovisual (ICA).

title: Verba para promoção da lusofonia desce 2,38% para 41 milhões de euros
snippet: O Orçamento do Estado para 2027 prevê uma redução de 2,38% para a promoção da lusofonia, que baixa de 42 para 41 milhões de euros, mantendo o novo regime do ensino de português como "principal objetivo".

title: Freguesias vão ter subvenção geral de 440,1 ME
snippet: As freguesias vão receber no próximo ano uma subvenção geral de 440,1 milhões de euros (ME), segundo a proposta do Orçamento do Estado para 2027 (OE2027) entregue hoje no parlamento.

title: OE2027 prevê 17 ME para combater violência doméstica e tráfico de seres humanos
snippet: O Orçamento do Estado para 2027 (OE2027) prevê 17 milhões de euros para a prevenção da violência doméstica e o combate ao tráfico de seres humanos, segundo o documento hoje entregue na Assembleia da República.

title: Encargos com PPP da saúde sobem para 254 milhões de euros
snippet: O Orçamento do Estado para 2027 (OE2027) prevê 254 milhões de euros de encargos com as parcerias público-privadas (PPP) do setor da Saúde, mais 34 milhões do que os 220 milhões previstos para este ano.

title: Estado prevê arrecadar 3.796 ME com imposto sobre combustíveis
snippet: O Governo prevê arrecadar 3.796 milhões de euros em 2027 com o imposto sobre os produtos petrolíferos e energéticos (ISP), mais 186 milhões do que o estimado para este ano, segundo a proposta de Orçamento do Estado para 2027.

title: Apresentação da proposta de Orçamento pelo ministro das Finanças
snippet: Joaquim Miranda Sarmento acaba de apresentar no Ministério das Finanças a proposta de Orçamento do Estado para 2027.

title: Verbas para Ensino Superior, Ciência e Inovação caem 7,6%
snippet: As verbas para as áreas do Ensino Superior, Ciência e Inovação deverão diminuir em 7,6% no próximo ano, segundo a proposta de Orçamento do Estado para 2027 (OE2027), que define uma despesa consolidada de 3.855,4 milhões de euros.

title: Taxa de solidariedade no IRS do tempo da `troika` alinhada com 9.º escalão
snippet: Lisboa, 08 out 2026 (lusa) -- A proposta de Orçamento do Estado para 2027 sobe o patamar de rendimentos a partir do qual incide a taxa de solidariedade de IRS que desde a `troika` tributa os rendimentos mais altos, alinhando-a com o 9.º escalão.

title: Governo descongela valor das propinas a partir de 2027/2028
snippet: O Governo vai descongelar, a partir do ano letivo 2027/2028, o valor das propinas das licenciaturas, que não sofre alterações desde 2020 e será atualizado à taxa de inflação, segundo a proposta de Orçamento do Estado para 2027 (OE2027).

title: Verbas para Ambiente e Energia caem 3,2% com efeito do PRR
snippet: A área do Ambiente e Energia tem para o próximo ano cerca de 2.200 milhões de euros, menos 3,2% do que no ano passado, devido ao efeito do PRR, segundo a proposta de Orçamento do Estado.

title: Governo melhora previsão de crescimento da economia este ano para 2,3%

title: Orçamento da Justiça aumenta 9% para mais de 2,1 mil milhões de euros

title: Anne Carson. A escritora que quebrou a fronteira entre géneros literários

title: Verbas para a Saúde caem 1,5% no próximo ano

title: Pequena agricultura e pesca com subsídio de 0,06 euros/litro no gasóleo colorido

title: Reforma do Estado com dotação de despesa total de 107,6 ME

title: Corporações de bombeiros voluntários com financiamento de 37 ME

title: 15h Ministro das Finanças já entregou proposta de Orçamento

title: Governo prolonga isenção de IRS e TSU nos prémios de produtividade e de desempenho

title: Valores que definem os nove escalões de IRS atualizados em 3,88%

title: Bolsas de criação literária atribuídas em março são pagas este mês diz Governo
snippet: A ministra da Cultura, Juventude e Desporto, Margarida Balseiro Lopes, comprometeu-se hoje com o pagamento durante o mês de outubro das bolsas de criação literária atribuídas em março a 42 autores.

title: Analistas moçambicanos querem reformas no sistema eleitoral com responsabilização da CNE

title: Dados em segredo de Estado ficaram a salvo de ciberataque
snippet: Uma empresa informática que trabalhou com três entidades públicas de informação e defesa foi alvo de um ciberataque. Foram roubados 120GB de dados, posteriormente colocados à venda na internet. As empresas esclarecem que não foi divulgada informação confidencial.

title: "Cristiano Ronaldo vai despedir-se da Seleção da forma que quiser"
snippet: O treinador do Sporting, Rui Borges, foi questionado sobre do diferendo de Cristiano Ronaldo e Jorge Jesus. O técnico sublinhou a "grandeza" do jogador formado no clube leonino.

title: PSP e GNR protestam por melhores condições nas carreiras
snippet: PSP e GNR exigem melhores salários e condições de trabalho. Os agentes e militares manifestaram-se junto ao Ministério da Administração Interna, em Lisboa.

title: Rendimentos dos portugueses com alterações em caso de aprovação do OE2027
snippet: A atualização das pensões pode prolongar-se até 2029, avançou o ministro das Finanças, Joaquim Miranda Sarmento na apresentação oficial do Orçamento do Estado. Os pensionistas vão receber, em 2027, mais 50 euros mensais.

title: Superintendente Pedro Moura será o novo Diretor Nacional da PSP
snippet:
O Superintendente da Polícia de Segurança Pública (PSP), Pedro Moura, vai ser o novo Diretor Nacional. Até agora, Pedro Moura ocupava o cargo de coordenador-geral da Unidade de Fronteiras e Estrangeiros da PSP.

Já o atual Diretor Nacional, Luís Carrilho, deverá ocupar o cargo de Oficial…

title: OE 2027: IVA e imposto sobre os combustíveis sem alterações. Escalões do IRS atualizados
snippet: Em matéria de impostos, a proposta do Orçamento do Estado para 2027, entregue esta quinta-feira, prevê a atualização dos escalões de IRS em 3,88 por cento. Debate-se, no entanto, em que medida este alívio poderá fazer frente ao aumento do custo de vida.

title: Governo açoriano já esperava proposta mas quer reforço para continuidade territorial
snippet: O secretário regional das Finanças disse hoje que a proposta do Orçamento do Estado (OE) para 2027 "está dentro daquilo que o Governo dos Açores esperava", mas reivindicou um aumento de verbas para a continuidade territorial.

title: Verbas do Fundo para Asilo, Migração e integração aumentam 45%
snippet: As verbas destinadas ao Fundo para o Asilo, a Migração e a Integração vão aumentar 45 por cento em 2027 em relação a 2026, um ano que teve o valor mais baixo desta fase do programa comunitário.

title: Investimento público situa-se em 2,8% do PIB em nova fase pós-PRR
snippet: O investimento público deverá situar-se em 2,8% do PIB em 2027, contra os 4,3% estimados para 2026, iniciando uma nova fase pós-PRR, segundo o relatório que acompanha a proposta de Orçamento do Estado para 2027 (OE2027).

title: Investimento previsto para expansão de redes de metros de Lisboa e Porto é de 174 ME
snippet: O Orçamento do Estado para 2027 (OE2027) prevê 174 milhões de euros para projetos de expansão das redes de metropolitano de Lisboa e do Porto, segundo a proposta entregue hoje no parlamento.

title: Apoiados mais 10 projetos em "Arte e Periferias Urbanas" devido a reforço orçamental
snippet: A DGArtes vai apoiar mais dez projetos artísticos no 2.º programa de apoio "Arte e periferias urbanas", cujos resultados foram conhecidos em maio, devido a um reforço de 500 mil euros daquele concurso anunciado pelo Governo.

title: Coesão Territorial com "variação negativa" em resultado da calamidade
snippet: O Programa Legado Coesão Territorial prevê uma despesa total consolidada de 725,4 milhões de euros na proposta de Orçamento do Estado para 2027, "uma variação negativa" comparativamente com 2026, em resultado da calamidade que marcou o ano passado.

title: Governo prevê excedente da Segurança Social acima dos 8.300 ME em 2027
snippet: O Governo estima que o excedente da Segurança Social atinja os 8.382,7 milhões de euros no próximo ano, segundo o relatório que acompanha a proposta de Orçamento do Estado para 2027 (OE2027).

title: Investimento em ferrovias e rodovias desce para 843 ME

title: Mergulhadores científicos comparam zonas com proteção e sem proteção na Madeira
snippet: Os mergulhadores científicos da expedição Madeira Ocean estiveram hoje a identificar espécies dentro e fora da reserva natural do Garajau e a conclusão é clara: há maior biodiversidade na área de proteção.

snippet: O antigo secretário executivo da Comunidade dos Países de Língua Portuguesa (CPLP) Marcolino Moco considerou hoje que a organização tem cumprido uma missão "meramente formal, diplomática", sem materializar princípios como a democracia e o Estado de direito.

snippet: Os detidos faziam parte de um grupo de cinco portugueses, entre os quais, dois jornalistas.

title: PSP deteta indícios de maus-tratos e irregularidades em lar ilegal em Sintra
